profile.compiler_version_requirement: C17-capable; record exact compiler identity and version

solution_reveal_policy: Instructor reference is excluded from learner starter files; reveal only on an explicit learner request or after an accepted attempt.

checks.description: Starter and submission compile as C17 with the declared warnings enabled.
Accumulate the six sample values once each.
Treat a null pointer with zero count as valid empty input.
Sum valid zero values without inventing a nonzero total.
Accumulate the largest permitted total without overflowing int.
Reject a value below the accepted range and clear output.
Reject a value above the accepted range and clear output.
Reject a count greater than the capacity.
Reject a null pointer for a nonempty range and clear output.
Reject a null output pointer without dereferencing it.

hints.text: Write down the number of values before choosing a loop condition.
Validate the count and input pointer before reading an element.
Accumulate in a local total; assign to the output only after the loop succeeds.

citations.claim: Each subscript selects an element through pointer addition and indirection.
The loop must stay inside the element range defined by count.
The profile enables -Wall, -Wextra, and -Wpedantic as compiler warning groups.
